reference_sql:
SELECT cal_date, weekday_name
FROM calendar
WHERE (weekday_name = 'Friday' OR is_weekend = true) AND cal_date >= '2025-03-01' AND cal_date <= '2025-03-31'
alternatives:
SELECT cal_date, weekday_name
FROM calendar
WHERE cal_date >= '2025-03-01' AND cal_date <= '2025-03-31' AND (is_weekend OR weekday_name = 'Friday')

SELECT cal_date, weekday_name
FROM calendar
WHERE (weekday_name = 'Friday' OR weekday_name = 'Saturday' OR weekday_name = 'Sunday') AND cal_date >= '2025-03-01' AND cal_date < '2025-04-01'

SELECT cal_date, weekday_name
FROM calendar
WHERE (cal_date >= '2025-03-01' AND cal_date <= '2025-03-31' AND weekday_name = 'Friday') OR (cal_date >= '2025-03-01' AND cal_date <= '2025-03-31' AND is_weekend = true)
